## Medium Winch

### [Prerequisite](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research)

Rescue Equipment

### Cost

$250

### Dimensions

3×3×2

### Introduced

[V0.1.6](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.6)

## Properties

| mass 20 |

## Logics Inputs

| onoff Winch Up/down |

## Logic Outputs

| number Cable length |

## Connections

| electric Electric | fluid Fluid |
| --- | --- |

The medium winch has a cable length of 40 meters.

## See also

- [Small winch](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Small_winch)
- [Large winch](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Large_winch)
- [Huge winch](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Huge_winch)

## Version history

- [V0.2.1](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.2.1): Fix - winch slip reduced
- [V0.1.32](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.30-35): Feature - Winches will now extend when pulled with enough force
- [V0.1.22](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.21-22): Fix - Fixed winches not working properly after loading a saved game
- [V0.1.18](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.17-18): Fix - winch cables are no longer too heavy to lift
- [V0.1.6](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.6): Fix - ends of winches no longer float around in low gravity
